name: Krea 2
description: Generate high-fidelity images from text with Krea 2. Choose Large for max fidelity or Medium for speed; supports aspect ratio, creativity, seed, and optional style references.

action.description: Generate high-fidelity images from text with Krea 2. Choose Large for max fidelity or Medium for speed; supports aspect ratio, creativity, seed, and optional style references.
action.name: krea/v2/large/text-to-image

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

creativity.description: Controls how loosely the model interprets the prompt. Higher values produce more creative results that may drift from the prompt; lower values stay closer to the prompt.
creativity.title: Creativity

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.
prompt.title: Prompt

quality.description: Generation quality. Large is highest fidelity; Medium is faster and cheaper.
quality.title: Quality

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed
